Introduction

Song Yuqi is a Chinese dancer, singer-songwriter, rapper, composer, and model under Cube Entertainment. She is best known as the main dancer, lead rapper, and sub vocalist of the girl group i-dle, formerly known as (G)I-DLE

Yuqi was a model before becoming a trainee under Cube after performing CLC's High Heels and G.E.M.'s Bubble in 2015. She has always been passionate about dancing, even back when she was still a student in China. Yuqi is now known as i-dle's Cutie.

Yuqi debuted under Cube Entertainment as a member of i-dle on May 2, 2018, with their mini-album "I am", and the corresponding title song, "LATATA".

In 2019, Yuqi became a cast member for the seventh season of the Chinese TV "Keep Running".

On May 13, 2021, Yuqi made her solo debut with her album "A Page", including the lead singles "Giant" and "Bonnie & Clyde".
